text: Brilliant breakdown. The section explaining how contiguous KV cache allocation blocked concurrent requests was eye-opening. We observed the exact same memory exhaustion pattern on our internal vLLM cluster.
Great synthesis of the empirical trade-offs. Would love to see a follow-up benchmarking chunked prefill vs speculative decoding under varying context windows.
The finding that chain-of-thought length expands purely from reinforcement learning rewards without human demonstrations is one of the most consequential shifts of the year.
The anti-inflammatory endothelial protection observed within 8 weeks prior to significant weight reduction aligns perfectly with clinical biomarkers we track in post-infarction cohorts.
Can corroborate this 100%. Migrated from 3 EKS clusters to Nomad on bare metal Hetzner nodes last year. Reduced monthly cloud bill by 78% and haven’t had a single CNI outage.
